newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bank CSOB says cuts key rates 100 bps.
newsitem.headline: Czech bank CSOB says cuts key rates 100 bps.

text.p: Czech bank Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s. (CSOB) said on Monday it was cutting its base lending rate for up to one-year credit by one full percentage point to 19 percent.
The bank said it was also lowering its prime rate to 18 percent from 19 percent.
CSOB last cut its prime rate to 19 percent from 20 percent on June 25 after lowering the base rate to 20 percent from 21 percent the previous day.
The central bank has begun lowering its rates after hiking them during May's attack on the crown.
The Czech National Bank lowered its Lombard rate to 23 percet from 50 percent as of Friday June 27.
The CNB's repo rate fell to 18.2 percent on Monday from previous 18.5 percent.
